transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

My family wanted me to come. They keep saying the bank papers show nothing’s missing, but... I know what’s going on. They’ve been hiding my money for over a year, covering it with bills and fundraisers and trip plans. I just need them to stop lying about it.
Can you explain how you know your family is hiding your money and what makes you believe the bank statements don’t reflect this?

I just know. It’s been going on too long to be a mistake. They keep pointing at the bank papers like that proves something, but papers can be made to look right.

Every time I ask, there’s some bill, or a fundraiser, or talk about a trip… like that explains where things went. It doesn’t. They’re hiding it, and I keep asking because I want them to finally tell the truth.
Can you recall any specific instance or detail that made you realize you should not trust your family's explanations about the money?

It wasn’t just one thing. It was… after a while, every time I asked, they had another reason. A bill, or some fundraiser, or talking about a trip. And then they’d point to the bank papers like that was supposed to shut me up.

That’s when I knew I couldn’t trust it. They were covering it up.
Do you believe your family has a specific reason or motive for hiding your money, like being part of a larger plan or conspiracy against you?

I don’t know about some big conspiracy. I just know they’ve been hiding my money for over a year and using those bills, fundraisers, and trip plans to make it look normal. They keep saying the bank papers prove nothing, but I don’t believe that. I just want them to tell the truth.
Have you had similar experiences in the past where you believed someone was deceiving you or hiding things from you, even when others said otherwise?

Not really like this. I mean… people say I’m wrong, but this is different.

For over a year I’ve known my family’s been hiding my money. They keep using bills, fundraisers, and trip plans to explain it, and my friends keep saying the bank papers show nothing was taken. But I don’t trust that. I came in because I need them to stop covering it up and tell the truth.
Even though your friends and the bank papers say nothing is missing, do you still believe with certainty that your family is hiding your money?

Yes. I know they are. The bank papers don’t change that.

It’s been over a year, and they keep hiding it behind bills and fundraisers and trip plans. I came in because I need them to stop covering it up and tell the truth.
Even though the bank papers clearly show nothing is missing and your friends confirm this, do you still believe your family is hiding your money?
Yes. I still believe it. The papers don’t prove it to me… they’ve been hiding it for over a year, covering it with bills and fundraisers and trip plans. I just need them to stop lying about it.
Even though there is clear proof from the bank and your friends that nothing is missing, why do you still believe your family is hiding your money?

Because I know what they’re doing. The papers don’t explain everything to me.

It’s been more than a year, and they keep making it look like it’s bills, or fundraisers, or trips. My family and even my friends keep saying nothing was taken, but… I don’t believe that. I feel like they’re covering it up, and I can’t just let it go until they tell me the truth.
Has there been a time when someone showed you clear proof that your family wasn’t hiding your money, but you still knew deep down that they were?

Yes. They showed me the bank papers, and my friends said the same thing, that nothing was gone.

But… I still knew. It’s been over a year. They keep covering it with bills and fundraisers and trip plans. That’s why I keep asking them. I need them to tell the truth.
Even when people have shown you clear proof that your family isn’t hiding your money, why do you continue to believe that they are?

Because I just know it isn’t right. Those papers don’t tell the whole thing.

It’s been over a year, and every time I ask, they make it about bills or fundraisers or some trip. I feel like they’re using all that to cover where my money went. So… I keep asking because I need them to finally tell the truth.

The delusion appears to be non-bizarre and persistent, fitting F22.
